Full project instructions for AI agents (architecture, tech stack, workflows,
pitfalls) live in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root—read that file first.
It is the single source of truth shared by Copilot, Claude Code, and any other
agent working in this repo; keep it, not this stub, up to date.
